_comment: The single source of truth for site_config section names. Several places used to keep their own copy — getAllConfig and the /api/config allowlist among them — and adding a section meant remembering all of them. Missing one silently broke its CMS editor with 'Invalid config key' while the public page rendered fine. Edit here only.
_rendered: Sections getAllConfig fetches, and the ones a missing row will fail the build over. The table also holds rows from an earlier version of the site (featured_work, journey, expertise, process) that nothing reads; leaving them out keeps them from being serialised into every page's payload.
_editable: Sections with a CMS editor, and the allowlist /api/config enforces. Must be a subset of `rendered` — a key that is editable but not rendered would save changes that never reach the site. `testimonials` is rendered but has no editor yet.
